title: Sensitive resource exposure
priority_reason: Existing outcome evidence indicates possible success; prioritize corroboration.
condition: If sensitive resources were actually returned
conditional_impact: Disclosure or subsequent unauthorized access may follow; content and sensitivity remain unverified.
next_action: Review historical responses and route exposure settings
escalation_condition: If historical response content or file-access records establish that non-public file content was returned or read, investigate the exposed information and affected scope and consider restricting the affected route.
if_deferred: Deferring investigation leaves harm unresolved and logs may be overwritten, preventing later verification.

title: Unintended processing or information access
priority_reason: Investigation order follows existing rule priority and outcome, not organizational impact or success probability.
condition: If an applicable vulnerable operation interpreted or executed the input
conditional_impact: Unintended execution or data access may occur; execution, changes and harm are unverified.
next_action: Correlate application, database, host records and historical responses
escalation_condition: If application, database, host or browser evidence establishes unintended processing, data access or modification, or script execution caused by the input, investigate affected operations and data and consider function restrictions or detailed investigation.
if_deferred: Deferring investigation leaves harm unresolved and logs may be overwritten, preventing later verification.
